column1: # ZAP rule policy (spec §25.7), read by ZAP (-c) and checked by tools/zaprules (make zap-baseline).
# One line per rule: <rule id> TAB <IGNORE|WARN|FAIL> TAB <reason> TAB <expires YYYY-MM-DD>.
# Every alert of level Medium or High fails the scan unless its rule is IGNORE here; a FAIL rule
# fails at any level. Every line needs a written reason and an expiry at most 180 days ahead;
